verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's first-party docs mention an official PowerShell module for bulk operations across users, devices, and groups. This gives scriptable command-line access, and an official GitHub support repo supplies helper scripts and API examples. It is a PowerShell-bound module rather than a documented standalone CLI, and nothing ties it to AI or agent workflows. Missing for 10: a dedicated cross-platform official CLI, CLI reference docs and install details, machine-readable or agent-oriented output, and independent hands-on corroboration.
